signInExpired: Sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.

move.title: Move Hermesh to the Applications folder?
move.body: Hermesh needs to be in the Applications folder to run in the background and update automatically. It will reopen from there.
move.failedTitle: Couldn’t move Hermesh to the Applications folder
move.failedBody: Drag Hermesh to the Applications folder in Finder, then open it from there.

signer.declined: Windows asked for permission to set up Hermesh’s signer, and permission wasn’t granted. Without it, this PC can’t store your owner key.
signer.notAdmin: Only an administrator account can make this PC a trusted device. Join as a machine only, or approve on another device.
signer.uacOff: User Account Control is turned off, so other programs could access your key. Turn it on to make this PC a trusted device.
signer.noTPM: This PC doesn’t have a TPM 2.0 security chip to store your owner key.
signer.failed: Hermesh’s signer couldn’t be set up (error {{code}}).
signer.notRunning: Hermesh’s signer didn’t start. Please try again.
